_README: Used ONLY where the two primary annotators disagree and cannot resolve it between themselves. One decision per disagreement. The adjudicator never sees FormFair output. Validate with: npm run validate -- templates/adjudication.template.json adjudication

decisions._EXAMPLE: A stage-one disagreement: was this a personal-name control at all? Omit the rule field entirely for stage one.
decisions.reason: Why this label and not the other. Name what the two annotators each relied on.
decisions.catalogueClause: The exact clause of catalogue-v1.0.0 you applied.

decisions._EXAMPLE: A rule disagreement. The rule field names which of FF-01..FF-05 is being decided.
decisions.reason: Why this label and not the other.
decisions.catalogueClause: The exact clause of catalogue-v1.0.0 you applied.
